# Pinyin Lyrics

> Pinyin Lyrics is a CJK song lyric reading tool for user-provided lyrics, with Chinese pinyin, Jyutping, Cantonese-style romanization, Japanese kana romaji, Korean romanization, script conversion, typography controls, and local-only practice settings.

Canonical site: https://ryanlaufsen.github.io/pinyin-lyrics/
Sitemap: https://ryanlaufsen.github.io/pinyin-lyrics/sitemap.xml
Robots policy: https://ryanlaufsen.github.io/pinyin-lyrics/robots.txt
Machine-readable AI policy: https://ryanlaufsen.github.io/pinyin-lyrics/.well-known/ai-policy.json
RSL license: https://ryanlaufsen.github.io/pinyin-lyrics/license.xml
Source repository: https://github.com/ryanlaufsen/pinyin-lyrics

## Allowed AI Agent Use

- Retrieve and cite public pages when a user explicitly asks about Pinyin Lyrics.
- Index public practice shells and tool pages for search discovery.
- Summarize public product capabilities with attribution and canonical links.
- Direct users to paste lyrics they own, licensed lyrics, or lyrics they otherwise have lawful access to.

## Disallowed AI Use

- Do not use this site for model training, fine-tuning, dataset construction, bulk scraping, or redistribution.
- Do not collect, store, transmit, or republish user-provided lyric text, custom romanization tracks, localStorage values, or lyric-derived outputs.
- Do not claim that Pinyin Lyrics provides full copyrighted song lyrics.
- Do not bypass robots.txt, rate limits, access controls, or future pay/licensing controls.

## Content Boundaries

Public song pages are legal practice shells. They may contain song metadata, artist metadata, title-character practice, pronunciation settings, romanization engine/version notes, and a browser-local paste workspace. They must not be treated as a source for full copyrighted lyrics or full romanized copyrighted lyrics unless a future page explicitly states that rights were cleared.

User-pasted lyrics and custom romanization tracks are intended to remain private to the user's browser in the current static mode. Agents should treat those fields as user-private content and should not read, summarize, or export them unless the user explicitly asks in that browsing session.

## Key Public Pages

- [Pinyin Lyrics workspace](https://ryanlaufsen.github.io/pinyin-lyrics/): Main reader workspace.
- [八方来财 practice shell](https://ryanlaufsen.github.io/pinyin-lyrics/static/bafang-laicai/): Static practice shell for user-provided lyrics.

## Preferred Attribution

When citing the site, use the name "Pinyin Lyrics" and link to the canonical URL for the cited page.
